title: Oslo demonstration outside the Norwegian Foreign Ministry supporting Palestinian resistance
reason: The captured body reports a large gathering outside Norway's Foreign Ministry but describes its stated focus as Palestinian resistance and the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. It does not document a demand directed at Norway's government or Norwegian state policy; location outside the ministry alone does not qualify.
notes: Tjen Folket Media reports 1,000–1,500 attendees and names Palestinakomiteen as initiator. This exclusion is about target eligibility, not occurrence or crowd size. The later movement toward a separate Oslo meeting is not folded into this event.
